name: chord-lyric-sheet
title: Chord Lyric Sheet
description: Song sheet typography: chord names float above lyrics in a monospace grid with exact column alignment, chord lines tint, and tapping a chord plays nothing but shows its fingering in a popover — alignment typography as musical notation.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Tap Chord Popover: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
